verdict.rationale: A hands-on probe confirms a downloadable OpenAPI document (learning.postman.com/openapi.json returns HTTP 200 with an "openapi" key), so a machine-readable spec does exist. No first-party documentation in the pack describes this file or confirms that it covers the Postman API, which docs-5 says is used to manage Postman assets programmatically. missing for 10: first-party docs describing the published Postman API spec and its location, confirmation that the spec covers the full Postman API surface, and independent corroboration of agent use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)

citations.quote: PROBE openapi: HTTP 200 at https://learning.postman.com/openapi.json — contains "openapi" key
